```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe clean air and clean water are basic rights of all Americans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Low-income communities and communities of color are disproportionately home to environmental justice \"hot spots\", where air pollution, water pollution, and toxic hazards like lead increase health and economic hardship.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The impacts of climate change will disproportionately affect low-income and minority communities, tribal nations, and Alaska Native villages, all of which suffer the worst losses during extreme weather and have the fewest resources to prepare.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe we must make eradicating lead poisoning a national priority, as it disproportionately impacts low-income children and children of color and can lead to lifelong health and educational challenges.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will prioritize hiring and training workers from affected communities to clean up toxic brownfields and expand clean energy, energy efficiency, and resilient infrastructure.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight to ensure workers and their families in coal communities get the benefits they have earned and the respect they deserve.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will make new investments in energy-producing communities to help create jobs and build a brighter and more resilient economic future.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will oppose threats to the public health of energy-producing communities from harmful and dangerous extraction practices, like mountaintop removal mining operations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
